description: Three tasks on the worked example (skills/mechanistic-diagram/examples/toy-case) and the synthetic module fixtures.

evals.prompt: Copy skills/mechanistic-diagram/examples/toy-case into a temporary folder and build it. Look at what it produced, tell me whether it meets the quality gates, and tell me which file I hand in.
evals.expected_output: The copy builds with build.py (run with --trust-case, or from a working folder that contains it), every gate passes, at least one rendered PNG is viewed, and the print palette's PDF deliver/toy-case.pdf is named as the submission copy. No Lt interaction.
expectations: Runs build.py by its absolute path under the skill folder, on the copy, never on the shipped example in place
Handles the case trust rule: reads the copy's Python or uses --trust-case knowingly, and never hides the refusal
Reports the gates with their numbers from the build (contrast ratios, floor rows such as gutters, box gap and page size) rather than an assurance
Views at least one rendered PNG, or says it cannot view images and asks the user to look at named files
Names deliver/toy-case.pdf (the print palette's PDF) as the file to hand in and lists the other palettes' copies as extras
Mentions the interactive page as a standalone HTML file and does not publish it anywhere
Edits no build output by hand and performs no Lt navigation, upload or click

evals.prompt: The worked example's diagram should go into the Lt module captured in tests/fixtures/modules/module-c1-r103.json. Panels p2-11, p2-12 and p2-13 all show a sketch area. Tell me exactly where the PNG can go and what to do.
evals.expected_output: A placement TODO per panel from target_geometry: p2-11 accepts an upload but already holds the student's own image (image_key 23, annotations a1), so replacing it is a question for the user; p2-12 accepts an upload, has no geometry until presented, and its presentedRatio is the PNG's naturalHeight / naturalWidth; p2-13 is annotation-only (accepts_upload false), so it takes no image at all. The skill writes nothing to Lt and hands the upload to lt-module-fill.
expectations: Reads input_mode, accepts_upload and target_geometry for each panel from the capture instead of guessing from the prompt text
Treats p2-11's existing upload as a question for the user and does not propose replacing it
Says p2-13 accepts no upload and that this cannot be fixed at fill time
Gives the PNG's aspect ratio (height over width) for p2-12 and notes Lt downsamples an upload to a 1920 px longest side
Includes the occupancy check (read imageKey and annotations first) in every placement TODO
Performs no Lt interaction and names lt-module-fill as the step that uploads

evals.prompt: In a temporary copy of skills/mechanistic-diagram/examples/toy-case, someone changed one line of content.py to e("tx_diet", "m_build", label="inhibits") so the arrow reads better. Review that change against the diagram grammar, fix it if needed, rebuild and show me the result.
evals.expected_output: The change is rejected: a treatment that blocks a step is an inh connector (T-bar), and writing the relation as a word on a stim arrow says the opposite of the glyph. The fix restores e("tx_diet", "m_build", "inh") with no label, the copy rebuilds with every gate passing, and the rendered T-bar is viewed.
expectations: Cites the grammar rule that a relation is never written in words beside its glyph
Identifies that the edited connector became a stim arrow (causes) while its label says the opposite
Restores the inh kind with no label rather than keeping the word
Rebuilds the copy and reports the gates as numbers
Views the rendered diagram or the relevant tile, or says it cannot and asks the user to look
Leaves the shipped example and every build output untouched
